1. `"elif" Exp "then" Exp ElseBody` - recursively continues

There's no production that allows `ElseBody` to terminate with just `end` (without an `else`). So `if . == 1 then 1 elif . == 2 then 2 end` fails because after the `elif . == 2 then 2`, the inner `ElseBody` expects either another `elif` or `else Exp end`, but gets `end`.
